text_block_list.text:
The fall series has begun. All of El
Condor Pasa's
rivals have grown stronger
and are off to fine
starts.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Graaaah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It's Спешл Уик! Спешл Уик makes a

sweeping victory in the first race of the
fall!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She's overtaken the competition with a
late surge
on the final stretch!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I'll pass anyone in front of me! Even
Suzuka and
El!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
This racer isn't just a cutie anymore!
With guts
and an outstanding fighting
spirit, she's coming
for the top spot in
Japan!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Hyaaah!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And Грасс Вандер wins! Her steadfast

performance and serene spirit kept all
the other
runners at bay and secured
victory!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
I can only be brave and keep moving
forward.
This fall, I'm searching for even
higher ideals.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Such perfection! Can anyone bring down
this
sturdy fortress this autumn?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Although, it should be noted that the
crowd's
enthusiasm this fall is certainly
higher than other
years.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And that's all thanks to a specially
planned event
by Эль Кондор Паса.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Spe! Grass! Our special performance is
finally
starting!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All of our practice—all that dancing and

singing—has all lead up to this moment!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's right, El! This is exactly what
we've been
working toward!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I thought this performance
was just a
side show for the main event...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You two aren't even listening...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, everyooone! The
three of us
are about to make this beat
soar!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса, Спешл Уик, and
Grass
Wonder's quickly assembled unit
takes the stage
and the event's concert
is a huge success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: A little later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All righty! Next up, how about a chat
with all of
us?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This event's been a huge success so far,
if I do say
so myself. But it must be
said...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This is all to kick off the start of the
upcoming G1
series!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
That's right. There are a lot of big races
coming
up in the fall!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And the three of us each have our own
goals. El's
running in the Japan Cup—
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, Grass. My goal isn't the
Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: It isn't?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The murmurs of the crowd grow loud.
Everyone
was under the impression that
El Condor Pasa was
aiming for the Japan
Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let me ask everyone a question. My goal
is to
become the strongest racer in the
world... but
what does that mean?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Of course being number one amongst all
the
world's strongest is a big part of it.
But let's think
about it for a sec.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
What if it turns out there are no strong

competitors at the Japan Cup?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Would I really be able to say I'm the
world's
strongest in that case, even if I
won? No! Not at
all.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna become the world's
strongest racer,
that means everyone
around me has to be strong
too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Being the strongest in the world makes
you a king
of kings! That means your
opponents must also be
kings!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Ohhhhh!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
Lucky for me, I'm surrounded by the
loveliest of
amigas.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Spe and Grass are among the strongest
racers
from around the country.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But it's not enough! Not for me, and not
for them!
We still haven't reached our
final goal!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Just like our performance today, we're
gonna
compete on the same stage,
combine our
strengths, and shoot for the
stars!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We're gonna become world-class...
together!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Now that I've run a ton of races, I
understand.
The rivalries you should
focus on first are the
ones around you.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Spe and Grass have gotten hella strong.
Before I
can focus my energy on the
world, I have to
surpass them!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So I'm gonna soar. After today, I'm off to
the
Japan Cup, and then... the Arima
Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Only after beating these two in both
races can I
move on to challenge the rest
of the world in an
overseas tour.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I gotta get out there and win! Only then
can I call
myself the strongest racer in
the world!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She really is an entertainer, and she
harnesses all
of that talent in her speech.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She brings drama to the competition.
This is the
style of a wrestler, and the
style of El Condor
Pasa...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've got it, El! I'll go to the Japan Cup
too!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: I wanna beat the person who managed to beat Suzuka! I have to if I want to be the best Umamusume in Japan!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And I'll go to the Arima Kinen. I'll give it

everything I've got.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I knew this day would come eventually,
El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That's why I reached out to you when
you were
struggling. For you, for me,
and for both of our
futures.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I respect you, El, but I won't just let you
fly off
overseas.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
By the will of the blue sky, I will be the
one who
claims victory.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The stage has been set. Or rather, El
Condor Pasa
has set the stage with the
help of everyone who
believes in her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The fall and winter G1 series is going to
be
intense—a high-level clash of rivals...
and the
ultimate form of entertainment.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for the three of us to face
off! Who
will come out on top? The
Gutsy Girl from
Hokkaido, the Brazen
Blue Ogre, or the
Unyielding Condor?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Let's get rrrrready to rrraaace!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Spe and Grass
